Access | Virus KC
Description
An even more powerful strain of the Virus was released in 2002 to replace the entire B Series line-up. The Virus C. Polyphony is expanded from 24 to 32 voices! Otherwise the synth engine is virtually the same as the B series. Three oscillators, one sub osc., two independent multi-mode filters, two ADSTR envelopes, three LFOs, 16 arpeggiators, 32-band vocoder, five FM synthesis modes and 16 part multitimbrality. The C series offers an expanded mod matrix with 6 source and 9 destination slots, 98 effects, wood side panels, and more! A new 3-band EQ section is available as well as an Undo/Redo function.
The Virus KC, is the classy keyboard version of the Virus C. It features 61 semi-weighted keys responsive to velocity and aftertouch. There are also individual and assignable Pitch and Mod wheels. Wood panels and a layout that remains faithful to the module's intuitive design.

Velocity
As with a piano, the harder you hit a key, the louder the sound, unlike most organs which always produce the same loudness no matter how hard you hit a key.
Aftertouch
Pressing a key after you activated it. Channel Aftertouch, no matter which key, it will send a Channel message. Poly Aftertouch, sends the pressure per key instead of the whole channel.
Values for OSC, LFO, Filter, Envelope are per voice unless stated otherwise.
